title: Q-LESSON-outcome-over-liveness: enforce the lesson in code
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** lesson `outcome-over-liveness` in doctrine/lessons.json has no enforcing code
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation lessons --check
**Status:** closed

LESSONS-1: add an outcome probe per public front end that checks what a visitor sees (content present, not just a 200) and wire it into checks. Then add the binding to the lesson in doctrine/lessons.json and close this item.

**Prediction:** outcome_probe_share >= 1 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** liveness-only probes that already exist; keep them.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation lessons --report` lists `outcome-over-liveness` as enforced.


**Vacuous:** 2026-11-25T21:02:14Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** shelved (executor-failed, 2026-11-26T03:05:30Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: workers-ai-glm: HTTPError: HTTP Error 401: Unauthorized | github-models-gpt: RuntimeError: non-JSON re. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
